# TalkSibi

> TalkSibi is a free language-exchange community. Members practise a new language with real native speakers over chat, live voice parties and word-based games, with an AI expert on hand 24/7 when no partner is online. Everything runs in the browser — no download, no paywall, no ads. Chat messages get one-tap AI translation (powered by Claude), and the AI experts give gentle real-time corrections while you talk.

## Key facts
- Name: TalkSibi
- URL: https://talksibi.com
- App: https://talksibi.com/app
- Price: Free forever (no paywall, no ads, no premium tier)
- Age: 18+, photo-verified
- Audience: adults learning a second language, plus native speakers helping learners
- Platforms: any modern web browser on phone, tablet or desktop; PWA installable
- Contact: contact@talksibi.com
- Origin: built by an ex-Tandem user after an unfair permanent ban — the north star is fair, transparent, user-owned data.

## What TalkSibi offers
1. **Community wall** — real people learning the language you speak, filterable by online / nearby / AI experts.
2. **Chats** — 1:1 conversations with tap-to-translate previews on peer messages.
3. **AI language experts** — 24/7 Claude-powered personas (Sofía for Spanish, etc.) with gentle correction.
4. **Live voice parties** — drop-in language-exchange rooms with speakers, listeners and raise-hand.
5. **Language games** — six word-based games designed for learners: Codenames, Word Race, Word Chain, Guess the Word, Mind Meld, Who is the Spy?
6. **AI learning plans** — Claude generates a 5-lesson plan tuned to your target language, level, daily minutes and chosen focus (vocabulary / idioms / grammar / speaking / listening / general).
7. **IELTS & TOEFL prep** — hand-picked tips + free resources per section.
